status: Curated pulse and meter hypotheses for the fourth Strum Along additions batch (rock/pop strummed songs towards ~100, 28 October 2026), covering every first pick and fallback, informed by SongBPM tempo listings checked against Karaoke Version, chord-sheet, sheet-music and tempo-database sources; not exact-upload timing gold. Prepared before the recordings were analysed, so ranges may need revision after the first grid check; where sources disagree on metrical level the status says so and the range is widened. This file holds the the fallbacks (not imported) of the v4 batch: the frozen draft builder takes at most 64 recordings per pack, so the batch is split into packs strumalong-additions-v4 and -v4b.
